tagline: A synthesized tom drum: pitched sine body with a pitch drop and noise
description: A tom drum voice made from a sine oscillator with a decaying amplitude envelope, a fast downward pitch sweep and a short noise burst, followed by fixed low-pass and high-pass filters. Every MIDI note plays the same tom at the Pitch setting, so you tune it with the knob rather than the keyboard; velocity sets the level. Use it for programmed tom fills or as a basis for electronic percussion.

features.name: Body pitch
features.description: Pitch sets the sine body frequency from 40 to 300 Hz (default 90 Hz); the note number is ignored.

features.name: Pitch drop
features.description: Pitch Env (0 to 3) and Bend (0 to 1) together set how far above the base pitch each hit starts before falling back over about 50 ms.

features.name: Decay
features.description: Sets the body's exponential decay from 0.05 to 2 seconds.

features.name: Noise attack
features.description: Noise (0 to 1) mixes in a white-noise burst that dies away in about 20 ms, adding stick attack.

features.name: Four-voice playback
features.description: Up to four overlapping hits ring out at once, each a one-shot that plays to the end of its decay regardless of note-off.
